# Jetforge Labs

> Jetforge Labs is a small studio that makes apps for the things that eat your time: typing what you could say, hunting for what you just had, remembering everything else. It also builds a few custom tools for others.

Jetforge Labs OÜ is a small studio. Everything is built, shipped and supported by the same people.

## Apps

Every app is a download for the Mac, notarized by Apple, and updates itself. Most are free; Dilo and Macbrow have a paid Pro. Download page: https://jetforgelabs.com/apps

- **Dilo:** writes what you say in any app, and turns calls into notes. Everything runs on your Mac. macOS 26+. 14-day free trial of everything in Pro, no card and no account; after the trial Basic stays free: dictation with fn in 19 languages, dictionary, history, voice notes, Markdown and text export, and reading and searching everything you recorded. Pro is 49 EUR, one payment, up to 3 Macs, lifetime updates (AI cleanup, meetings with summary and voices, Ask your Vault, built-in local model). Learn more and download: https://getdilo.co
- **Macbrow:** turns the notch into a shelf for your files, a cleaner for your screenshots, a meeting alert, a music player and a calendar. macOS 15+, made for MacBooks with a notch. 14-day free trial of everything, no card and no account; after the trial the Shelf, music, battery, clock and basic appearance stay free. Pro is 7.99 EUR, one payment, no subscription, up to 3 Macs. Buy Pro: https://jetforgelabs.gumroad.com/l/macbrow
- **Checkmate:** a task list for your Mac and iPhone, synced through your own iCloud. No account, no sign-up, free. macOS 15+, iOS 18+. iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6828836039
- **LimitBar:** shows your Claude Code and Codex limits in the menu bar. For developers. macOS 14+, free.
- **Berth:** a Dock for your Mac that stays out of the way, with live window previews and a shelf. macOS 15+, free.
- **DeepSpy:** finds what's eating your disk and cleans it up: a space map, junk finder and app uninstaller. macOS 15+, free.
- **Tide:** a modern terminal for your Mac, built native. macOS 15+, free.

## Custom software

If the friction is bigger, or specific to your team, we can build that too: a tool for how you work, an internal app, a product of your own. Write to hello@jetforgelabs.com.
